growth.product_desc: Maintain product positioning, verified facts and use cases for website and social content.
growth.requirements_hint: Customize structure, tone and focus; tasks maintain data and platform rules.
growth.product_empty: Add real product or feature facts before research and creation.
growth.usecase_empty: Add a product, then record supported user tasks and use cases.
growth.product_first: Add product facts under Product and audience first.
growth.opportunities_desc: Identify worthwhile website and content opportunities from user problems and search demand.
growth.opportunity_empty: Start with a real user problem, then research keywords, competition and landing pages.
growth.seo_flow: Demand and keywords → Page planning → Content and tools → Distribution and citations → Ongoing review
growth.numbers_hint: Leave blank without measured data; do not enter estimates.
growth.campaigns_desc: Plan website, Xiaohongshu, Douyin and X content around one user problem, then review results.
growth.campaign_empty: Create a campaign from an opportunity, or plan a product promotion directly.
growth.plan_empty: Choose Plan channel content to create platform briefs.
growth.video_hint: Video drafts need real footage; descriptions and scripts are not finished videos.
growth.metrics_desc: Import sourced daily snapshots to inspect visits and signup, activation and payment events.
growth.define_events: Confirm signup, activation and payment event definitions in positioning.
growth.metrics_empty: No conversion data yet. Import a real report; leave unmeasured metrics blank.
growth.coverage_note: Only imported data is summarized; date and metric coverage may be incomplete.
growth.csv_hint: CSV columns: date,source,campaign_id,visits,signups,activations,payments,provenance. Use YYYY-MM-DD dates and nonnegative integer counts. Leave unmeasured fields blank; use unknown for unattributed sources. campaign_id is optional; provenance records the data source and definitions. Do not import both channel totals and their campaign breakdowns.
growth.csv_too_large: CSV files must be no larger than 2 MB.
growth.overview_product: Grow {name} through user scenarios, content, distribution and conversion.
growth.overview_desc: Define your product and audience, research opportunities, create content and measure results.
growth.goal_empty: Define the signup, activation or other product goal for this stage.
growth.overview_counts_note: Conversion metrics are imported event counts for the last 30 days; blank means unmeasured.
growth.quick_company_desc: Define your audience, verified features and use cases.
growth.quick_opportunities_desc: Find relevant search and content opportunities with demand.
growth.quick_campaigns_desc: Connect website and social content around one user problem.
growth.plugin_missing: The social plugin is not ready. Continue with product and website work; check the social plugin in Annulo Settings → Project.
growth.remote_note: Publishing, collection and Google authorization require the owner’s computer online; AI tasks run in Annulo.
growth.ga4_note: GA4 key-event totals are shown separately. Review signup, activation and payment counts with confirmed definitions under Conversion data.

marketing.import_title: Import marketing content and SEO plans
marketing.import_note: Check the product and additions. Existing edits are preserved. Historical dates are not scheduled, and completed tasks are not publication receipts.
marketing.file_large: Packs must be under 900 KB. Import larger source documents in batches.
marketing.preserved: Sources changed for {n} existing records. Current edits were preserved; review them individually.
marketing.plans_desc: Reuse existing content and assets, then plan variants by theme, account and angle.
marketing.plans_empty: Import marketing data or plan your first campaign.
marketing.historical_note: Original production states and source material are preserved. Publication claims need an account, URL and time. Generation and body import create drafts only.
marketing.proof_missing: Add a real case, public result or product footage before making claims.
marketing.legacy_receipt_note: This is a legacy snapshot, not a verified publication or product conversion.
marketing.receipt_note: Enter the actual publishing account, URL and Beijing time. Saving records a receipt without publishing externally.
marketing.account_note: The target account is unbound. Prepare drafts and verify the connected account before publishing.
marketing.seo_desc: Group similar queries under one primary page. Verify the page and evidence before editing or publication.
marketing.seo_empty: Import a query/page map or research your first opportunities.
marketing.search_unknown: Search data unavailable; values remain unknown
marketing.difficulty_note: Human relative difficulty {n}/5, assessed {date}. This is historical SERP research, not tool KD. Recheck before execution.
marketing.page_metrics_note: Impressions, clicks, CTR and position summarize the matched page, not this individual query. Blank means unmeasured.
marketing.today_empty: No pending actions. Import data or prepare product facts from your website.
marketing.receipt_missing: A legacy record claims publication; this project's account, URL and time are unverified.
marketing.advance_seo_why: Start from a clear user question and existing evidence in the query/page map.
marketing.pipeline_note: Cumulative work records overlap; each content item may have multiple reviews. Legacy claims are not verified receipts. This is not a user funnel.
marketing.review_rule: Social reviews run at 24h, 72h and 7d; website reviews at 7d, 14d and 28d. Only real receipts create schedules; the running desktop refreshes the queue every 6h.
marketing.review_empty: No verified receipts yet. Verify historical publications or publish content to create review tasks.
marketing.growth_desc: Queries → Primary pages → Content and evidence → Publication → Reviews.
marketing.search_period: Google Search Console · {start} to {end} · Synced {synced} (Beijing time)
